title: Outside audit of W in the gated FCH micelles: the wall-off control still holds the cargo at 3.4-3.5x, so containment is by construction
summary: Operator-run audit (audit.md) under the wall-off rule. Fresh seeds 51 and 52 reproduce S, I, B and D and a cargo contrast of 24-25x (100% of body-frames and daughters >= 2x). With the shell's adsorption drift removed (chi_q=0; q keeps its body-restricted source, decay and transport, the gate is kept, the bodies are bit-identical) the ring disappears but the cargo is still held at 3.41x and 3.51x, 99.5-99.8% of body-frames and 73 of 74 daughters >= 2x. A gate by blurred q (no ring) gives 4.6x; a uniform gate by the domain mean of q gives 2.6x. The 2x containment comes from the body-restricted cargo source plus a cargo slowed by body-made q, not from the self-made wall; the ring adds about 7x on top. W is therefore by construction under PROTOCOL's rule; the claim's own pack_chiq0 and c01's chiq0 and shell_lowD arms already showed this. S, I, B and D are supported.

observations.I: rerun/seed51/FACTS.md: 52 components at the end, 39 persistent tracks, 0 merges. rerun/seed52/FACTS.md: 51 at the end, 30 persistent, 0 merges. Discrete micelles of bounded size (R_eq about 5 px).
observations.B: rerun/seed51/radial.png: shell q peaks at rho 0.75, rim/core 11.5, rim/outside 5.11, 258/259 individuals membrane-like. Seed 52: 10.7 and 4.89, 238/241. Removing the drift (chi_q = 0) removes the ring (rim/core 0.93). The layer is placed by a drift potential written against u (line 125), but q is made only inside the bodies (line 128), so it counts under the quasi-equilibrium clause.
observations.D: rerun/seed51/FACTS.md: 18 persistent splits, max generation 3, 0 merges. rerun/seed52/FACTS.md and lineage.png: 19 persistent splits, max generation 4, 0 merges, in synchronized waves. Founders formed from noise, so generation 2 or more suffices.

verdicts.limitation: W: the cargo is made only in the bodies (world.py line 123) and gated by q, which is also made only in the bodies (line 128) and decays slowly (kdq=0.002), so q's domain mean slows the cargo everywhere; with the wall's localization removed the cargo stays above 2x in nearly every body-frame. The ring is real (B) and raises the contrast about 7x, but it is not what meets the W gate. Daughters inherit at a median of about 8x, not the claimed ~10x: the fission necks leak cargo. The 1.5x resolution test was not repeated. The checker notes the default measuring band skips about 2.5 px on each side of the contour; with a near band the wall-off arm is at 2.5x with 75-78% of body-frames >= 2x, still above the gate for most of the bodies' lives.
